verification.notes: FAA rules do not impose a blanket ban on drone flight in Provo. Controlled-airspace operations require authorization through LAANC or DroneZone, and UVU maintains a separate authorization process for flight on university property. Exact operations remain subject to altitude, temporary, crowd, and campus restrictions.
